standard_prerequisites.name: For any object E there is a distinguished triangle relating sections with support, E itself, and the pushforward from the complement
standard_prerequisites.use: Provides the triangle used to prove quasi-coherence.

standard_prerequisites.name: For j the inclusion of a retrocompact open, the pushforward Rj_* preserves quasi-coherence of cohomology sheaves
standard_prerequisites.use: Gives that i_*R\mathcal{H}_T(E) has quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves, proving (1).

standard_prerequisites.name: The support functors form an adjoint pair between complexes on X and complexes with support in T
standard_prerequisites.use: Together with (1) identifies i_*R\mathcal{H}_T as the right adjoint on D_QCoh, proving (2).

core_obligations: Set U = X setminus T and j : U to X the inclusion; by the cohomology triangle lemma there is a distinguished triangle i_*R\mathcal{H}_T(E) -> E -> Rj_*(E|_U) -> ... in D(O_X) (proof lines 1053-1058).

Part (1): Rj_*(E|_U) has quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves by the quasi-coherence direct-image lemma, using retrocompactness of U; the triangle then gives that i_*R\mathcal{H}_T(E) has quasi-coherent cohomology sheaves and support in T (proof lines 1059-1062).

Part (2): by the adjointness in the cohomology support lemma, i_* R\mathcal{H}_T is right adjoint to the inclusion of complexes with support in T; part (1) shows it lands in D_{QCoh, T}, so it is the right adjoint of the inclusion D_{QCoh, T} -> D_QCoh (proof lines 1062-1064).
proof_roadmap: Set up the distinguished triangle for sections with support (proof lines 1053-1058).
Prove quasi-coherence via retrocompact pushforward (proof lines 1059-1062).
Conclude the right-adjoint property from the adjointness of support functors (proof lines 1062-1064).
